notes: Demand generated from French national census sources (INSEE), the same national pipeline used across this project's mainland-France maps (not yet individually scored on the registry). Residence population: INSEE Filosofi 2021, a 200m population grid (published at 200m, total population including all ages). Jobs and commute flows: INSEE MOBPRO 2021, the national home-to-work mobility survey giving commune-to-commune employed-worker flows measured at place of work. For each MOBPRO flow between an origin and destination commune, individual pops (~60 people each) are drawn: the residence point is a Filosofi 200m grid cell within the origin commune (chosen with probability weighted by that cell's resident population), and the job point is a Filosofi 200m grid cell within the destination commune (chosen the same way, weighted by resident population — job locations are not independently weighted by employer or business data, only by where people live in that commune, a known limitation of this pipeline). A minimum 3km origin-destination distance is enforced (re-drawn up to 15 times on violation) to avoid unrealistic walkable-distance commutes dominating the model. Special demand points (airport, university, hospital) are placed on their real terminal/campus/site coordinates verified via OpenStreetMap, with capacities sourced from official traffic/enrollment/bed-count statistics, not from the census. Driving times/distances computed with OSRM on a Réunion OSM extract; a 1.5x congestion multiplier is applied to trips >=3km (no official congestion index found for the island; estimated from its constrained single-corridor road network). Map tiles and building/ocean foundations built with Depot from OpenStreetMap + Overture.
